### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

_   _         __  _  __                    _ \___/|_| |_|| |  |_|  | || .__/ \__,_|\___|_|\_\___|_| \_\     /_/ | | The usage of runtime packers by malware authors is very common, as it is a technique that helps to hinder analysis. Furthermore, packers are a challenge for antivirus products, as they make it impossible to identify malware by signatures or hashes alone. In order to be able to analyze a packed malware sample, it is often required to unpack the binary. Usually this means, that the analyst will have to manually unpack the binary by using dynamic analysis techniques (Tools: OllyDbg, x64Dbg).
